task.definition: Arena mode='blink' with period P; at a hidden switch step in the last third of the episode the period doubles to 2P. Flag = thrust < -0.5 within 16 steps after the switch.
task.metrics: detection latency (steps from switch to first flag), false-alarm rate per 100 steps before the switch
